landing.title: Apply to HPU-affiliated colleges in one place
landing.subtitle: Register, complete your profile, choose colleges and track admission — entirely on your phone.
landing.feature1Body: Pick up to 6 BA preferences or 3 BSc preferences across colleges in a single round.
landing.feature2Body: We check your Class 12 marks against course rules and show what you qualify for.
landing.feature3Body: From submission to seat allotment to admission letter — all visible in your dashboard.

howItWorks.title: How admission works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps from registration to roll number.
howItWorks.step1Body: Five quick sections: personal details, address, academics, claims and bank.
howItWorks.step2Body: Browse eligible courses across HPU colleges, pick preferences and pay the application fee.
howItWorks.step3Body: Colleges verify your documents and the state publishes the merit list.
howItWorks.step4Body: Respond to your seat offer, pay the admission fee and download your admission letter.

help.title: Helpdesk
help.subtitle: We're here to help with your admission.

faqs.q: Can I apply to multiple colleges?
faqs.a: Yes. BA allows up to 6 preferences and BSc up to 3 preferences across colleges.

faqs.q: When do I pay the admission fee?
faqs.a: Only after a seat is allotted. Until then, you only pay the small application fee.

faqs.q: What if my document is rejected?
faqs.a: You'll see a notification on your dashboard with the reason and a link to re-upload.
Your data is stored locally on your device for this demo and is never shared without consent.
